attchmntText: Lexus Granito (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Lexus Granito India Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 24th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 1,546.49 lakhs for the quarter and 1,902.72 lakhs for the half year. The company reported a loss before tax of 393.50 lakhs for the quarter and 657.69 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were negative 1.85 rupees for the quarter and negative 3.14 rupees for the half year. Total assets stood at 10,532.39 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review of these results.
